section: The affirmative case and stock issues

slots.purpose: The 1AC is one speech that offers one short plan and a few separate reasons it is good.
slots.subject: A large speech bubble on the left. Inside it sits one plain white card with a single thick straight line across it, like a one-sentence plan. From the right edge of the bubble, two short straight paths run out to the right. Each path ends at a small sprouting plant with two round leaves.
slots.composition: The bubble fills the left third, its tail pointing down-left. The two paths leave the bubble at slightly different heights and run right in gentle parallel lines. The two plants sit at the right end of the paths, on a thin light grey ground line. Nothing else is in the picture.
slots.colors: The speech bubble is aff blue #0055b8, because the 1AC is the affirmative's speech. The card is white with a black outline and a black line. The paths are light grey #cfd4da with black edges. The plants are white with black outlines and mid grey #7d8690 stems. No red.
slots.avoid: No people, no podium, no flags or trophies at the end of the paths.
slots.alt: A blue speech bubble holds one card with a single line; two paths lead from it to small plants: one plan, and the separate good results it causes.
slots.caption: One plan, and a few reasons it is good.

slots.purpose: The aff must prove all five stock issues, and under a strict stock issues judge losing any one loses the round.
slots.diagram_spec: A simple building front: a flat roof beam on top of five equal pillars standing on a base line. The roof beam is labelled "Aff wins". Each pillar has its name in bold and a short question under it, left to right: "Harms: is there a real problem now?", "Inherency: will it last without the plan?", "Solvency: does the plan fix it?", "Significance: is it big enough to matter?", "Topicality: does the plan fit the topic?". The Topicality pillar has a small note "own sheet" under it. Below the base, one line of text: "Strict stock issues judge: if the neg clearly wins any one pillar, the neg wins." Outlines ink #16191d, pillars white, roof and base light grey #e1e4e8. No blue or red.
slots.alt: Five labelled pillars (harms, inherency, solvency, significance, topicality) hold up a roof marked Aff wins; losing one pillar can lose the round.
slots.caption: The five stock issues and the question each one asks.

slots.purpose: A harm is a real problem now: real people are hurt, in a way you can see and count.
slots.subject: A short row of five simple faceless figures standing in a line, waiting outside a small plain building with a closed door. The building is a simple box with a pitched roof and one closed door, like a small rural clinic.
slots.composition: The building stands on the right third on a thin light grey ground line. The line of figures runs from the left toward the door, evenly spaced, all facing right. The door is clearly shut. Lots of white space above.
slots.colors: Figures are filled in mixed flat greys (#e1e4e8, #cfd4da, #7d8690) with black outlines. The building is white with black outlines; the door is mid grey #7d8690. No blue or red.
slots.avoid: No faces, no medical cross or red cross symbol, no signs on the building, no sad expressions or tears.
slots.alt: A line of simple figures waits outside a small building with a shut door: a harm is a real problem that hurts real people now.
slots.caption: A harm is a real problem, happening now, to real people.

slots.purpose: Inherency means the problem will not fix itself: left alone, it stays or grows.
slots.subject: Two side-by-side views of the same plain wall section (no bricks), each with a plain round clock face above it. In the left view, the wall has a short crack and the clock hand points up. In the right view, the same crack is longer and wider and the clock hand has moved a quarter turn. Nothing has repaired it.
slots.composition: Two equal panels, left and right, separated only by white space (no frame or line between them). Each panel: a wide rectangular wall section on a thin ground line, the small clock centred above it. The crack starts in the same place in both and runs further in the right panel.
slots.colors: Walls are light grey #e1e4e8 with black outlines. The crack is ink #16191d. Clock faces are white with black outlines and one black hand, and have no numbers or tick marks. No blue or red.
slots.avoid: No tools, no people, no numbers on the clocks, no bricks with writing.
slots.alt: The same wall shown twice: later, its crack is longer. Inherency means the problem lasts or grows unless the plan acts.
slots.caption: Left alone, the problem does not fix itself.

slots.purpose: Solvency means the plan fixes the problem, often most of it rather than all of it.
slots.subject: A plain wall section with a long crack. A sturdy rectangular metal-style plate is bolted over most of the crack with four round bolts. A short end of the crack still shows past one edge of the plate.
slots.composition: The wall section is wide and centred on a thin ground line. The plate sits slightly left of centre and covers about three quarters of the crack. The uncovered end of the crack pokes out on the right side of the plate. Nothing else in the picture.
slots.colors: Wall is light grey #e1e4e8 with black outlines. Crack is ink #16191d. The plate is white with a thick black outline; the bolts are mid grey #7d8690 circles. No blue or red.
slots.avoid: No hands, tools, sparks or shine on the plate. Do not make the plate look shiny or metallic with highlights.
slots.alt: A plate is bolted over most of a crack in a wall, with a small part still showing: a plan can solve most of a problem, not all of it.
slots.caption: Solvency does not need to be total to be worth it.

slots.purpose: Significance can be shown by a count (many cases) or by how serious each case is.
slots.subject: Two objects side by side on a ground line. On the left, a tall neat stack of many small identical cubes. On the right, one single large dark stone of about the same height, so heavy that it presses a slight dip into the ground line.
slots.composition: Both objects stand on one shared thin ground line, the stack on the left and the stone on the right, with equal space around each. They are about the same height. Nothing else in the picture.
slots.colors: The small cubes are white with black outlines. The stone is solid ink #16191d. The ground line is light grey #cfd4da. No blue or red.
slots.avoid: No scale, no numbers on the cubes, no people.
slots.alt: A tall stack of small cubes beside one heavy dark stone: significance can come from how many people are hurt or from how serious the harm is.
slots.caption: Big enough to matter: by the count, or by how serious it is.

slots.purpose: Show an advantage as a mechanism: the plan sets off a series of steps that lift a good result into place, and each step must work.
slots.subject: A simple pulley lift: a rope runs from a crank wheel on the left, over two round pulley wheels, and down to a plain square block on the right. The block is being lifted from the ground up toward a plain shelf.
slots.composition: The crank sits low on the left, the two pulley wheels hang from a plain top beam, and the rope runs left to right. The block hangs halfway between the ground and the shelf on the right. Nothing else is in the picture.
slots.colors: The block being lifted is aff blue #0055b8. The crank, wheels, rope, beam and shelf are ink and white with light grey #e1e4e8 fills. No red.
slots.avoid: No people or hands, no chain or rings, no stones or water, no arrows.
slots.alt: A crank, two pulleys and a rope lift a blue block toward a shelf: an advantage works only if every step from the plan to the good result holds.
slots.caption: Each step of an advantage must work, from the plan to the good result.

slots.purpose: Case defense makes the aff's advantage smaller; a case turn flips it into a reason to vote neg.
slots.subject: Three thick plain arrows in a row, each pointing horizontally. The first is a long arrow pointing right. The second is the same arrow, but much shorter, still pointing right. The third is the same arrow turned around, pointing left.
slots.composition: The three arrows sit side by side across the frame, left to right, at the same height, with wide white space between them. Each arrow sits on its own short light grey base line. Nothing else in the picture.
slots.colors: The first and second arrows are aff blue #0055b8: the aff's advantage, full and then shrunk by defense. The third arrow, turned around, is neg red #f2232d: the same chain now gives the neg a reason. Outlines are ink #16191d.
slots.avoid: No writing or symbols on the arrows, no explosions, no broken pieces.
slots.alt: A long blue arrow, a short blue arrow, and the arrow turned around in red: defense shrinks the advantage, a turn flips it to the neg.
slots.caption: Defense shrinks the advantage. A turn flips it.
